accepted_state: Initial eight-area capability expansion is complete.
Default operating phase is hardening, consolidation, outcome validation, and gap-oriented learning rather than default skill expansion.
GitHub mutation guard contracts remain CI-validated; native provider interception is deferred unless a controllable dispatcher surface becomes available.
Every live skill entrypoint has a consolidation classification and routing overlap clusters have machine-readable primary ownership rules.
Skill Acquisition is phase-gated and must not trigger a new expansion wave without explicit request or demonstrated gap.
Agent Engineering treats executor/model claims as candidate state and requires evidence-appropriate promotion into durable accepted state.
Tracing/evaluation and context write/select/compress/isolate contracts remain CI-validated.

Material DEDAL self-changes are now treated as experiments with an observed trigger, bounded hypothesis, comparable baseline, protected evaluation, regression inspection, and retain/revert/inconclusive outcome.
A candidate self-change must not rewrite the protected evaluator used to accept it, and task-specific benchmaxxing is invalid.
Self-improvement does not expand Creator authority, platform safety boundaries, or tool permissions.
Executable continuity checkpoint state remains CI-validated.
unresolved_risks: The public Core guard cannot intercept native provider GitHub tools unless the host routes mutation calls through it.
Eight skills remain NEEDS_EVIDENCE and should not be promoted to stronger consolidation decisions without representative outcomes.
Routing, verified-state, trajectory, context, and self-improvement contracts remain contract-level refinements until representative real-task evidence accumulates.
Some host surfaces do not expose sufficient comparable metrics or replayable state, so experiments may legitimately end inconclusive.
Fixed eval sets can be overfit; real failures should expand regression coverage and held-out checks should be preserved where feasible.

next_executable_step.action: Use the controlled experiment loop only when ordinary real work exposes a failure, measurable friction, explicit Creator request, or demonstrated gap. Freeze a comparable baseline, make the smallest owning-layer change, inspect held-in and held-out outcomes where feasible, and retain/revert/inconclusive truthfully. Promote the first genuine self-change experiment result as outcome evidence without inventing global gains.
